productName: SnapLabel — Sub-Millimeter Avery Label, Envelope & Barcode Merge for Docs & Sheets

shortVideo.fullText: Tired of merging spreadsheet rows into printable Avery mailing and barcode labels getting locked behind monthly subscriptions and external cloud portals? With SnapLabel, Sub-Millimeter Calibrated Avery Templates (Zero Drift) runs right where you already work. Built-In Scannable Code-128 Barcodes & QR Codes and Outputs Editable Google Doc + Print-Ready PDF—100% under your own custody. Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.

demoVideo.fullText: Need a better way to handle merging spreadsheet rows into printable Avery mailing and barcode labels, without handing your data to another monthly cloud landlord? Watch SnapLabel in action: Engineered with locked cell heights and margins for Avery 5160, 8160, 5163, 5167, and #10/DL envelopes so row 10 aligns as cleanly as row 1. Include crisp, scannable inventory barcodes or QR codes inside every merged label cell at zero extra tier cost. Plus, generates both a customizable Google Doc and a locked, print-calibrated PDF directly inside your Google Drive folder. Your customer mailing addresses, wedding guest lists, and warehouse SKUs never leave your Google account to render on an external server. Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.
